_comment: Cases reported from real briefs. Every entry here was a story that reached a
notification wrong, or a counterpart that must keep working after the fix.
Add one with:  npm run flag -- --id <slug> --expect topic=health <edition> <story-id>
Run them with: npm run eval
They also run as part of npm test, so a fix that breaks an older case fails CI.
Verdicts: topic, clusters, excluded, kept, headlineNot, summaryNot, headlineIndex
